cases.task: Choose the safe browser rule when an SSE event ID is an exact uint64 decimal above JavaScript's safe integer range but the JSON numeric sequence rounds to another value.

required_facts.text: MessageEvent.lastEventId preserves the exact decimal SSE cursor as text across the full uint64 range.
A JSON number parsed by JavaScript cannot exactly represent every uint64 sequence above 9007199254740991.
The server can include an exact sequence_decimal string and the client must require it to equal the accepted SSE ID before rendering the payload.
Missing, invalid, or divergent sequence_decimal must close fail-closed while preserving the accepted SSE cursor and rejecting the payload as evidence.
